title: Harmonize – UI Overhaul
description: Harmonize transforms your Minecraft experience with a unified visual design. Every container interface now features a consistent layout that perfectly aligns with your hotbar. No more jarring visual jumps between different workstations!
body:
# **✨ Harmonize**

> **"A mod that unifies and enhances all Minecraft interfaces, making them consistent, polished, and pleasant to use."**

Harmonize transforms your Minecraft GUI experience with a sleek, unified visual design. Every container interface—from crafting tables to enchanting stations—now features a consistent layout that perfectly aligns with your hotbar. No more jarring visual jumps between different workstations!

---

## 🎯 **What does this mod do?**

Ever noticed that Minecraft's menus feel… inconsistent? Different spacing, misaligned elements, and behaviors that vary from one menu to another. **Harmonize** fixes all of that.

**Simple. Clean. Harmonized.**

---

## ✨ **Key Features**

| Icon | Feature Description                                                                                   |
| :--: | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
|  ✨  | **Standardized GUIs:** Premium container interfaces with pixel-perfect alignment                |
|  🎯  | **Unified Positioning:** Consistent hotbar and inventory slot placement across ALL workstations |
|  🎨  | **Refined HUD:** Custom hotbar sprites and XP bars with a modern, sleek aesthetic               |
| 🖼️ | **Texture Consistency:** Adjusted item and block textures for a cohesive visual experience      |
| 🖐️ | **Universal Offhand:** Offhand slot accessible directly from every single container menu        |
|  🎭  | **Polished Interactions:** Consistent hover feedback, tooltips, and button hitboxes             |

---

## 🖐️ **Universal Offhand Slot**

One of the most essential quality-of-life improvements: **your off-hand slot is now available in ALL menus**.

No more closing chests or workstations just to switch your torch, shield, or crafting ingredients!

## 📋 **Supported & Improved Menus**

### ✅ Completed Overhauls

- **📦 Storage Containers:** Chest (Single & Double), Ender Chest, Shulker Box, Dispenser, Dropper, Hopper
- **🛠️ Crafting & Processing:** Crafting Table, Crafter, Furnace, Blast Furnace, Smoker, Brewing Stand
- **⚔️ Equipment & Upgrades:** Anvil, Smithing Table, Grindstone, Enchanting Table, Beacon
- **🎨 Decorative Workstations:** Loom, Cartography Table, Stonecutter
- **🐴 Animal Mounts:** Horse, Donkey, Mule, Llama (with chest & armor slots)
- **👤 Player Interfaces:** Player Survival Inventory, Villager Trading, Creative Mode Menu

## 🎮 **Compatibility**

| :-------------------------- | :--------------------- |

| **Mod Loader**        | `Fabric`             |
| **Dependencies**      | Requires`Fabric API` |

---

## 📥 **Installation**

1. Download and install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/).
2. Download and install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
3. Download the latest release of **Harmonize**.
4. Place the downloaded `.jar` file into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
5. Launch the game and enjoy!

---

## ❓ **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does Harmonize affect client performance or FPS?**

> **A:** No! It strictly modifies interface layout coordinates and texture rendering, introducing zero performance overhead.

**Q: Is it compatible with other GUI or inventory mods?**

> **A:** Yes, in most cases. Minor visual overlaps may occur if another mod aggressively overrides core vanilla container screens.

**Q: Does it work on multiplayer servers?**

> **A:** Yes! While it is primarily a client-side visual enhancement, installing it on the server ensures full container synchronization.
